mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is above its 50th percentile, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tight labor market with aggressive monetary policy, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during an economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 650,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS < 650000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth rate > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 60 trading days as robust economic expansion supports corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
